title: Twentieth-century famines summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Hasell, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data famine figures (CC-BY): ~100 million famine deaths in the 20th century; China's Great Leap Forward ~36 million; Bengal 1943 ~3 million; children under five usually one half to two-thirds of famine deaths. Clean version verified internally consistent (36/100 ~ one-third; 3/36 ~ one-twelfth) before injecting 3 defects.
